entities.summary: Sidney Charles Hudson was an American starting pitcher in Major League Baseball who played for the Washington Senators and Boston Red Sox (1952–54) who had a lengthy post-playing career as a pitching coach and scout. Born in Coalfield, Tennessee, he batted and threw right-handed, stood 6 feet 4 inches (1.93 m) tall and weighed 180 pounds (82 kg).
